cup.message: FPL creates the mini-league cup automatically. Fixtures appear here as soon as the draw is made (usually around GW34).

auto.headline: Season not started - nothing to report yet.

written._readme: Hand-written monthly round-ups. Keyed by month (YYYY-MM). Whatever is here replaces the auto-generated commentary on the Email round-up tab. Each entry takes either 'body_html' (rich, recommended) or 'body' (plain text, blank line between paragraphs). Claude drops a new entry in here each month; you never need to touch it.
